items.stem: What is the symbol used to represent percentage?
Rohan and Rajat bought shoes worth ₹500. Rohan got a discount of ₹125, while Rajat got a discount of 30%. Who got the shoes at a lower price?
If 384 out of 400 students voted in an election, what is the voting percentage?
What is the meaning of the word 'percent'?
If a glass of milk provides 8gm of protein and Meena needs 25gm of protein daily, what percentage of her daily requirement does she get from one glass of milk?
If 75% of a 19500 square meter field was sown with jowar, how many square meters were sown?
A cricket team played 20 matches and lost 40% of them. If the team had won 15 matches instead of the remaining, what would have been the winning percentage?
In an election, Deepti got 44% of the total votes, Trupti got 26%, and the rest did not vote for either. What percentage of the total votes did not go to either of them?
In the passage, it says that the symbol / is used in Geography for 'how many out of a thousand'. If the salinity of seawater is 35 parts per thousand, what is the percentage of salinity?
A cricket team played 20 matches last year. It lost 40% of the matches and won all the remaining matches. How many matches did it win?
If a team wants to increase its winning percentage by 10%, what should it do to the number of matches it wins?
In an election, Deepti got 44% of the total votes and Trupti got 26% of the total votes. What percentage of the total votes did not go to either of them?
A farmer has 14000 sugarcane seedlings. 700 seedlings were bad. What percentage of the seedlings were bad?
What is the percentage of bad sugarcane seedlings if 700 out of 14000 were bad?
In a class of 50 students, 20 students are boys. What is the percentage of boys in the class?
